subject: VectorLane connector readiness & technical validation
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@vectorlane.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@vectorlane.io
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VectorLane connector validation kickoff

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. VectorLane is ready to move to a joint technical validation so our teams can sign off on the connector and plan a Q3 joint launch. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm field mappings and auth modes (we support OAuth2 + API keys).
- Run an interoperability test with our staging dataset (PII-masked).
- Validate retry/backpressure behavior under burst loads.
- Exchange basic compliance evidence (SOC2 summary + data flow diagram).

I've attached our integration spec (v1) and proposed test matrix. Can your team run a 2-week validation sprint starting May 21? If not, propose alternatives.

Best,
Amit
VectorLane, Head of Partnerships
[Attachment: vectorlane_spec_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@vectorlane.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VectorLane connector validation kickoff

Amit —

Thanks, this looks great and reasonable. We can support a 2-week sprint but want to align on scope and deliverables first. I've looped in Marissa (solutions lead) and Sergio (partner ops/runbooks) to own the technical execution.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa to draft a mutual test plan (shared workbook) by EOD 5/15.
2) Sergio to provide our runbook template and staging access checklist.
3) Red-team acceptance criteria: mapping verification, auth flow test, latency/backpressure smoke, sample payload e2e.
4) Kickoff call 5/17 for 45 minutes to align owners and schedule.

Can you confirm the VectorLane staging endpoint and whether the dataset includes anonymized examples we can use? Also, please share SOC2 summary PDF and dataflow (we'll ingest into our compliance tracker).

Thanks — talk soon.
Ben
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@vectorlane.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: VectorLane connector validation kickoff

Hi Amit / Ben —

I've started the mutual test plan and uploaded an initial sheet to the shared Drive (link below). Early outline:

- Week 1: Sanity & auth (OAuth2 handshake, API key fallbacks), mapping smoke tests (10 sample payloads), basic telemetry.
- Week 2: Load & resilience (burst 100rps sustained 5m, graceful degradation checks), data fidelity checks, logging/audit verification.
- Acceptance: All mapping diffs <= 1% (sample set), auth flows succeed 100% during negotiated window, retries/backoff behavior documented.

Dependencies we need from VectorLane:
- Staging endpoints and API creds (scoped, time-limited).
- A small anonymized sample (200 records) and a schema definition.
- SOC2 summary and a contact for security QA.

Sergio — attaching the runbook template and a checklist stub below for visibility. We'll refine during the kickoff.

Marissa
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-test-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit@vectorlane.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: VectorLane connector validation kickoff

Amit —

Attaching the Redwood runbook template and a quick checklist that's what we'll use to declare a connector "validation-complete." Key items included: credentials scope verification, ephemeral token rotation test, KV caching behavior notes, and how to trigger a failover to our compatible-model fallback.

My notes / questions:
- Please confirm whether VectorLane will support rotating staging API keys every 24h for the sprint (we prefer short-lived creds).
- For load testing, can you expose a non-production endpoint that doesn't hit rate limits tied to production quotas?

We'll bring an SE to the kickoff to run through the mapping examples live.

Thanks,
Sergio
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-runbook-template.md (text/markdown)]

From: Elena Voss <elena.v@vectorlane.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@vectorlane.io>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: VectorLane connector validation kickoff

Thanks everyone —

We can confirm the 2-week sprint and the kickoff on 2028-05-17 at 10:00 PT. Action items from VectorLane side:

- Staging endpoints + API creds: will share by EOD 5/15 (short-lived keys OK).
- Sample payloads: will provide 250 anonymized records and schema by 5/15.
- SOC2 summary and network diagram: attaching to email thread and uploading to your Drive folder.
- Non-prod load endpoint: yes, we will provide a scoped endpoint for resilience tests.

Also sending an initial DocuSign link for the interop statement (internal approvals on our side). Please route to your legal as appropriate.

Elena
Director, Strategic Alliances — VectorLane
[Attachment: vectorlane-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
